subject.title: feat(sessions): add local timezone prefix to archive filenames

question: Should OpenClaw accept Option B, a local-date prefix plus canonical UTC suffix, as the persisted reset/deleted session archive filename contract for configured timezones?
rationale: This changes stored transcript artifact basenames and user-visible filesystem discovery semantics, so the compatibility shape should be explicitly accepted rather than inferred from unit tests.

options.title: Accept Option B After Coverage
options.body: Require QMD/archive reader coverage and real reset/delete proof, then accept the local-date prefix while preserving the UTC suffix as canonical.

options.title: Keep UTC-Only Archive Names
options.body: Reject filename changes for now and keep local-date discovery as a separate search/display problem or later product design.

options.title: Accept Current Narrow Shape
options.body: Allow the PR to land with QMD handling deferred, knowingly leaving prefixed archive-hit resolution as follow-up work.

recommendation.title: Accept Option B After Coverage
recommendation.body: Require QMD/archive reader coverage and real reset/delete proof, then accept the local-date prefix while preserving the UTC suffix as canonical.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent archive timestamp and normalization history makes this the strongest available owner signal for the persisted filename contract choice.
